description: This file contains functions and classes for managing application templates and instances in an app store CLI, including creating, deleting, and updating app configurations and files.

classes.name: BaseAppFork
classes.description: An object with methods to create and delete application instances, handling file system operations and configuration updates.

methods.name: getSlugFromAppName
methods.description: Generates a URL-friendly slug from an application name.

methods.name: getAppDirPath
methods.description: Returns the directory path for an app or template based on slug and type.

methods.name: updatePackageJson
methods.description: Updates the package.json file with new name and description.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new app or template directory, copies template files, and updates configuration files.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes an app or template directory from the filesystem.

methods.name: generateAppFiles
methods.description: Runs a build script to generate application files.
